messages:
incident-bot: Pager — possible auth header exfil detected from api-forwarder-prod. Honeytoken 'rt_honey_42' observed in external request logs. Severity: P2. Auto-created incident: INC-2950007777. https://incidents.redwood/INC-2950007777

grace-oncall: ack — I'm on it. pulling logs and adding sec.

alice-sre: looking at proxy logs now. three distinct IPs hitting the honeytoken over last 35m, all via the forwarder. request header shows X-Client-Auth: <redacted-honeytoken>.

bob-sec: thanks. do not rotate keys yet until we snapshot evidence. bob/sec will start forensics. preserve S3 objects and kubectl logs.

clara-ic: brief: timeline, customer impact, immediate mitigations. grace please coordinate with CS.

grace-oncall: quick status: no 5xx spikes, routing healthy. one service (payments-api) had a few client auth failures but looks like header probing, not valid tokens. unclear if any customer tokens were logged.

dan-cs: I've scanned support queue — no reported errors from customers. will prep comms if we confirm data exposure.

alice-sre: snippets from proxy (redacted):
```
2026-03-17T12:04:02Z GET /v1/payments 200 "X-Client-Auth: rt_honey_42" src=54.214.11.9
2026-03-17T12:06:11Z POST /v1/score 200 "X-Client-Auth: rt_honey_42" src=3.101.77.12
```
Third-party UA strings look like crawler-bot/1.0 and curl/7.68.

bob-sec: IPs belong to cloud-hosted brokers — reaching out to abuse contacts. spinning up packet capture on forwarder. runbook steps: preserve logs, snapshot /var/log/proxy, tag S3 prefix s3://redwood-prod/proxy-logs/2026-03-17 for retention, DON'T DELETE.

alice-sre: applied temporary ingress blocklist for the three IPs at the edge (CloudWAF rule 9876) and added a deny rule on the forwarder pods.

erin-eng: pushed a tiny config to drop headers with honeytokens at edge to avoid further propagation:
```
kubectl patch cm forwarder-config -n infra --patch '{"data": {"drop_headers": "X-Client-Auth"}}'
```
Will monitor for unintended side effects.

bob-sec: collecting evidence bundle now. CLI commands used:
```
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-prod/proxy-logs/2026-03-17 /tmp/forensics --recursive --no-progress
tar -czf /tmp/INC-2950007777-evidence.tgz /tmp/forensics /var/log/proxy/*.log
```
Tagging for legal hold.

frank-legal: keep copies in the secure case storage. don't destroy anything. once bob posts the bundle, legal will advise on notification obligations.

clara-ic: quick customer impact readout: no errors seen in customer-facing routes, no auth revocations yet. possible leakage of honeytoken-only; we must assume patterns indicate someone scraping logs or a misconfigured forwarder pushing headers to third parties. plan: rotate any service tokens that might have been included in logs historically, scrub and reingest clean logs, coordinate customer outreach if PII/real tokens found.

alice-sre: starting scrub job to remove honeytoken hits from S3 and replace with redacted records. running dry-run first.
```
python infra/scripts/scrub_proxy_logs.py --prefix 2026-03-17 --dry-run
```
Dry-run shows ~27 objects with honeytoken occurrences.

bob-sec: in parallel, enumerating keys referenced in logs. if any real API keys show up, we will rotate those. list will be provided in 30m.

grace-oncall: assigning next steps and handoff: grace -> alice for operational mitigation, bob -> sec on forensics, dan -> cs for customer monitoring. handoff to night oncall (harriet) at 20:00 UTC. please leave summary + ops steps.

clara-ic: Handoff checklist (leave in thread):
- mitigation applied: IP blocklist, header drop at edge, deny on forwarder pods.
- evidence: s3 snapshot path s3://incidents/INC-2950007777/evidence (bob-sec)
- scrub: in-progress (alice-sre)
- keys to consider rotate: TBD (bob-sec)
- legal: preserving evidence, will advise on disclosure (frank-legal)
- CS: monitoring support queue & customers flagged (dan-cs)

bob-sec: preliminary forensics note: honeytoken came from internal header logging that is forwarded to 3rd-party indexer via a misconfigured log-forwarder. we have isolated the forwarder config that allowed header passthrough. starting config hardening and will disable forwarding until we confirm clean pipeline.

ergine-eng: code owner for forwarder here — will disable auto-forward to external indexer and rotate forwarder credentials. will open PR and deploy hotfix.

frank-legal: request preserved timeline emails and list of any customers whose tokens appear in logs. legal will prepare notification template if needed.

grace-oncall: leaving for night shift — harriet-oncall is paged and has accepted. harriet, please review pinned checklist and keep incident declared until scrub & rotation complete.

harriet-oncall (automated): ack accepted. will review runbook at handoff.

clara-ic: final immediate actions: 1) complete scrub (alice), 2) rotate any leaked keys (bob & erin), 3) disable external forwarding (erin), 4) contact abuse at external IP hosts (bob). reconvene in #incident-bridges in 45m or sooner if new discoveries. :white_check_mark:
